arguments.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redraw Image 1 as one polished cartoon game sprite matching Image 2, which is STYLE AND CHARACTER IDENTITY ONLY. The exact original pixel sprite in Image 1 controls pose, facing, proportions, framing, visible parts and occlusions. Smooth bold black ink, clean bright cel shading. Dolphin pale blue-gray with soft cream/light-gray underbelly, rounded friendly head and smiling beak. Adult mermaid has flowing yellow hair, cyan headband, peach skin and a green swimsuit top. Convert any red/white skin dithering to solid natural peach shading. Dolphin and mermaid seen from BEHIND at the surface, turned inward toward each other. Large dolphin on left has its back to the viewer and its head turned to the right toward her; only a narrow side sliver of its pale cheek and near eye is visible, with back/shoulder dominating and no broad belly. Mermaid on right has her back to the viewer, long yellow hair covering almost all torso, cyan band high on her head, a tiny left-facing profile sliver of peach face. Her bent peach arm at bottom center reaches toward the dolphin at water level, hand lifted. Keep the inward turn, back view, hair/body coverage and relative height exact. Preserve the source silhouette and body visibility: parts underwater remain absent, never complete hidden characters, no full underwater bodies, no added tails unless visible in the source. Only thin cyan-and-white water ripples where shown. All drawn parts inside the canvas with transparent margin. Actual transparent RGBA background; no checkerboard, scenery, shadow, text, collage or pixel texture.
